Obasanjo spoke on Friday in Abeokuta, Ogun State, at the Ajibosin Platform, a public forum theme “Leveraging Artificial Intelligence to solve grassroots problems and accelerate National Development.” In April, Tinubu sai
articles.hausa_translation: Obasanjo ya bugi Tinubu game da aron bashi, ya ce ba shi da mahimma.
